first_broken_edge.finding: The deterministic verifier and causal telemetry are ready, but no immutable live capture has exercised and verified one complete two-baiter transfer-lane episode under legacy gameplay authority.
first_broken_edge.effect: Shadow authority cannot be considered for a default-off cutover until live evidence proves stable task identity, intent equivalence, exact native receipt joins, and physical progress for both baiters.

next_phase.objective: Run one normal isolated 10N Magmaw completion-watchdog capture with legacy-only authority, finalize normalized evidence, evaluate it with the reviewed verifier, publish compact evidence through DVC, and clean up the shard.

required_sequence: build the exact descriptor commit and retain a compact build receipt
apply canonical validation provisioning for only the isolated Magmaw shard
verify provisioning and frozen-roster readback before launch
start the normal capture controller without fixture-expansion replay
poll at the generated completion-watchdog heartbeat until a truthful terminal edge
finalize and independently demultiplex normalized schema-v2 evidence
run verify_magmaw_shadow_observation.py over the immutable normalized JSONL
publish compact receipts and DVC-backed raw evidence only after identity and demux gates pass
stop the worldserver, clean database leases and temporary runtime files, and evict local raw data after verified DVC push
pass_contract: the capture is exact-build, exact-profile, exact-roster, exact-attempt, exact-route, and identity-bound
legacy remains the only gameplay authority and no shadow proposal reaches native execution
one exact Magmaw lifecycle scope contains a complete transfer-lane episode with the same ordered fire-mage and hunter assignment on every active sample
both task histories are running, make semantic distance progress, and succeed without failed or aborted terminal states
all accumulated eligible shadow-versus-legacy comparisons are equivalent with stable actor, generation, keys, and immutable destination
each selected legacy candidate joins to an exact native launch receipt for the same actor and lifecycle scope
later receipt samples prove a strictly decreasing endpoint distance for both actors
the reviewed verifier returns pass and the capture finalizer, demux, forbidden-assistance, cleanup, and DVC publication gates pass

terminal_contract.pass: The verifier returns pass after a complete two-baiter episode and all evidence lifecycle gates pass.
terminal_contract.not_exercised: The run terminates truthfully but does not contain a complete two-baiter transfer-lane episode or eligible comparisons; do not tune gameplay and route a new bounded observation only after inspecting why the mechanic was not exercised.
terminal_contract.fail: Any divergence, ambiguity, assignment drift, task failure, receipt mismatch, lack of numeric progress, gameplay watchdog failure, infrastructure loss, identity failure, or publication failure blocks cutover.
terminal_contract.no_clear_requirement: This observation gate measures the transfer-lane slice. A Magmaw kill is useful progression evidence but is not allowed to hide a verifier failure or a non-exercised episode.

forbidden: changing C or C++ gameplay code, encounter policy, class rotations, movement, geometry, arbitration, priorities, assignments, or native planner tolerances
enabling shadow execution or accepting a shadow-only movement
using chainwielder_prestart_bundle, fixture-expansion replay, synthetic trace injection, GM assistance, teleport, invulnerability, threat assistance, or direct boss pull
using a fixed raid success timer or treating an emergency wall-clock cap as success
accepting action submission, the improved boolean, approximate timestamps, or approximate actor joins as physical progress
keeping duplicated raw logs, build trees, database snapshots, or unpushed generated evidence on local disk

promotion_gate.required_evidence: A reviewed verifier pass from one immutable authority-off live episode plus clean build, provisioning, identity, demux, cleanup, forbidden-assistance, and DVC publication receipts.
